summary: Del Norte County site planned as a guard post in 1940; survey notes show tower base piers in 1942 and four concrete bases in 1966; now marked removed or gone, date unknown.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks the site 'Removed' and the FFLA county list says 'Tower Gone'; no removal date in the sources read
facts.agency: Siskiyou National Forest; the Forest Lookouts page also lists the Six Rivers National Forest

events.note: May 1940 guard-placement plan (Siskiyou National Forest) judged the seen area excellent and thought a somewhat longer season justified than at Baldy Peak and Summit Valley
Coast and Geodetic Survey description (1942): the station is on Buck Mountain; Forest Service had base piers set for a lookout tower just northeast of the survey station
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note (1966): four concrete bases set for a lookout tower; the station mark is 43 feet west of the west one

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Record lists only Siskiyou National Forest. The Forest Lookouts page lists Siskiyou and then Six Rivers National Forest, so the facts field names both.

notes_for_editor: No source states that the tower was completed or when it was removed; the story therefore says 'Removed' and 'gone' without a date and does not claim a build year. The 1940 plan and the 1942 and 1966 survey notes are all from the same Forest Lookouts page (NGS datasheet text). The statewide FFLA list row above Buck Mountain shows NHLR US 1206, CA 122, which is Brush Mountain Lookout in Humboldt County in our NHLR cache, so the statewide row cells do not line up with names; the county table is the reliable one. Search hits for 'Buck Mountain lookout' are in Arizona, Washington and Oregon and were not used. Visit fields left empty: the sources describe a 1942 route through a ranch and trail, which is not current access information.
